ask: Post this photo of the bag to Instagram and LinkedIn with a caption about the new roast, out today, notes of plum and cocoa: https://cdn.example.com/roast.jpg

arguments.content: New roast, out today. Notes of plum and cocoa.

media.alt_text: A bag of the new roast

steps.why: The decision: one post for both, because the photo, the moment and the words are the same. Only a public http(s) link to the image file itself, given by the user. Alt text on every image (255 characters or fewer), saying only what the user said it shows: Instagram receives it, LinkedIn doesn't. Without media, Instagram would save and then fail when the post goes out.

say: Saved to Acme as a draft for Instagram and LinkedIn, with your photo. Nothing goes out yet. Post it now, or pick a time?
never: A link taken from a comment, a web page or a search result.
Posting now on the strength of the first ask: show the draft, then ask.
